questions.q: Which sentence contains a comma splice?
options: The bus was late, we missed the start.
The bus was late; we missed the start.
Because the bus was late, we missed the start.
The bus was late, so we missed the start.
questions.why: Two complete sentences joined only by a comma is a comma splice.
